relations.subject: Amy Heller
relations.object: Center National de la recherche scientifique
relations.evidence: Since 1986, Heller has been associated with the Center National de la recherche scientifique in Paris

relations.subject: Amy Heller
relations.evidence: She studied Art History at Barnard College of Columbia University (B. A. cum laude 1973)

relations.subject: Amy Heller
relations.object: National Institute of Oriental Languages in Paris
relations.evidence: Tibetan language and civilisation at the National Institute of Oriental Languages in Paris (diploma in 1979)

relations.subject: Amy Heller
relations.evidence: She earned her Ph.D. in 1992 in philology and history of Tibet at the École pratique des hautes études in Paris.

relations.subject: Amy Heller
relations.object: Centre for Tibetan Studies, University of Sichuan
relations.evidence: She is currently visiting professor since 2007 at the Centre for Tibetan Studies, University of Sichuan, Chengdu, China.

relations.subject: Amy Heller
relations.evidence: She was visiting professor at La Sapienza, university of Rome, Italy, in 2006 and 2008.

relations.subject: Amy Heller
relations.object: School of Oriental and African Studies
relations.evidence: 2011–2013, Heller has been a research associate at the School of Oriental and African Studies.

relations.subject: Amy Heller
relations.object: National Institute of Oriental Languages (INALCO Paris)
relations.evidence: 2014–2016, Heller has been lecturer on Tibetan Archaeology at the National Institute of Oriental Languages (INALCO Paris).

relations.subject: Amy Heller
relations.evidence: 2017–2018, Heller taught at University of Bern invited by the Institute of Science of Religions and Central Asian Studies. Subsequently, she is affiliated with this institute and taught Art and Architecture of Tibet and Mongolia in 2019–2020.
